note: Rejudged after runIPCP (pppoeclient/session.go) gained unsupported-protocol LCP Protocol-Reject dispatch and the connected no-NCP idle-period channel. Re-read RFC 1661 Section 5.4 ('Reception of a valid Configure-Reject indicates that when a new Configure-Request is sent, it MUST NOT include any of the Configuration Options listed in the Configure-Reject.'). In runIPCP, ProtoIPCP is admitted by clientSupportsProtocol, reaches ValidateLCPReply for Configure-Reject subset validation, and enters the unchanged LCPConfigureReject arm that clears requested.HasPrimary/HasSecondary, advances the Identifier and resends without the rejected options; the idle channel is nil on initial negotiation and only fires when no NCP is Opened on a connected renegotiation. All five tagged units are byte-identical: server MRU-only rejection preserves other options while all-option rejection yields an empty request; client LCP MRU/Magic/all-option cases assert exact surviving bytes, unchanged retransmission and no resurrection on later Nak; IPCP DNS control removes both or Secondary-DNS alone and learns no rejected server.
